authority.source: owner, 2026-10-11: "I authorize a small end-to-end cloud trial if feasible using existing access and ordinary resources. Choose the smallest useful trial that demonstrates automatic progression, independent checking, landing and post-merge verification. Prefer useful scoped work over artificial production changes made only to demonstrate the workflow." The two phases are open issues #1025 and #994, chosen by the plan-run improvement session as the smallest useful two-phase plan.
